builds.name: Bountiful Harvest: drain plus missing-health finish
builds.summary: Investigate high one complete Bountiful Harvest channel output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.

builds.hypothesis: The channel deals 60/90/120/150/180 + 0.45 AP magic per second for two seconds, then 12/14.5/17/19.5/22% enemy missing HP magic at the end. Rank-5 timed drain nominally totals 360 + 0.9 AP; the final 22% term must use the missing HP at its actual damage time, after prior damage.

kitEvidence.formula:
Fiddlesticks channels and drains the souls of nearby enemies, dealing [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage per second for 2 seconds, plus [12 / 14.5 / 17 / 19.5 / 22]% missing Health magic damage at the end. Fiddlesticks restores [25 / 32.5 / 40 / 47.5 / 55]% of damage as Health.

If Fiddlesticks ends the channel without interruption, the remaining Cooldown is reduced by 60%.
